CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.account_enabled()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.id=auth.uid() AND p.banned_at IS NULL)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM security_private.revoked_sessions r
 WHERE r.user_id=auth.uid() AND r.session_id::text=auth.jwt()->>'session_id')
 AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM security_private.mfa_required_users m WHERE m.user_id=auth.uid()) OR coalesce(auth.jwt()->>'aal','')='aal2')
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.courier_steps_version()
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$ select 34 $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.happy_hour_pct(p_store uuid, p_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now())
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  with l as (select (p_at at time zone 'Asia/Dushanbe') as t)
  select coalesce(max(h.discount_pct), 0)::int
    from happy_hours h, l
   where h.active and (h.store_id is null or h.store_id = p_store)
     and (
       (h.start_time < h.end_time and extract(isodow from l.t)::smallint = any(h.days) and l.t::time >= h.start_time and l.t::time < h.end_time)
       or (h.start_time > h.end_time and (
            (extract(isodow from l.t)::smallint = any(h.days) and l.t::time >= h.start_time)
         or (extract(isodow from (l.t - interval '1 day'))::smallint = any(h.days) and l.t::time < h.end_time)))
     )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_perm(p text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ SELECT public.account_enabled() AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles u WHERE u.id=auth.uid() AND u.banned_at IS NULL AND (u.role='admin' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.staff_members s WHERE s.user_id=u.id AND s.active AND p=ANY(s.perms)))) $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.my_perms()
 RETURNS text[]
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ SELECT CASE WHEN NOT public.account_enabled() THEN NULL WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles WHERE id=auth.uid() AND banned_at IS NULL) THEN NULL WHEN public.is_admin() THEN ARRAY['orders','support','finance','stores','content'] ELSE (SELECT s.perms FROM public.staff_members s WHERE s.user_id=auth.uid() AND s.active AND cardinality(s.perms)>0) END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.pilot_check_session()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF auth.role()='authenticated' AND NOT public.account_enabled() THEN
  RAISE SQLSTATE '42501' USING MESSAGE='account_blocked';
 END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.promo_guard_version()
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
